targets.quote: Member States shall implement the necessary measures to prevent deterioration of the status of all bodies of surface water, subject to the application of paragraphs 6 to 7b and without prejudice to paragraph 8;
targets.label: objective
indicators: status of bodies of surface water
targets.source: FIX-CONSOLIDATED: cross-reference widened from 'paragraphs 6 and 7' to 'paragraphs 6 to 7b' (new 7a/7b derogations inserted); re-sliced from 02000L0060-20260510.

targets.quote: Member States shall protect, enhance and restore all bodies of surface water, subject to the application of point (iii) of this paragraph for artificial and heavily modified bodies of water, with the aim of achieving good surface water status at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive, in accordance with the provisions laid down in Annex V, subject to the application of extensions determined in accordance with paragraph 4 and to the application of paragraphs 5 to 7b without prejudice to paragraph 8;
targets.label: objective
targets.timeline: at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive
targets.source: FIX-CONSOLIDATED: 'subparagraph (iii)' -> 'point (iii)' and 'paragraphs 5, 6 and 7' -> 'paragraphs 5 to 7b'; re-sliced from 02000L0060-20260510.

targets.quote: Member States shall protect and enhance all artificial and heavily modified bodies of water, with the aim of achieving good ecological potential and good surface water chemical status at the latest 15 years from the date of entry into force of this Directive, in accordance with the provisions laid down in Annex V, subject to the application of extensions determined in accordance with paragraph 4 and to the application of paragraphs 5 to 7b without prejudice to paragraph 8;
targets.label: objective
targets.timeline: at the latest 15 years from the date of entry into force of this Directive

targets.quote: Member States shall implement the necessary measures in accordance with Article 16(1) and (8), with the aim of progressively reducing pollution from priority substances and ceasing or phasing out emissions, discharges and losses of priority hazardous substances
targets.label: objective
indicators: emissions, discharges and losses of priority hazardous substances

targets.quote: Member States shall implement the measures necessary to prevent or limit the input of pollutants into groundwater and to prevent the deterioration of the status of all bodies of groundwater, subject to the application of paragraphs 6 to 7b of this Article and without prejudice to paragraph 8 thereof and subject to the application of Article 11(3)(j);
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Member States shall protect, enhance and restore all bodies of groundwater and ensure a balance between abstraction and recharge of groundwater, with the aim of achieving good groundwater status at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive, in accordance with the provisions laid down in Annex V, subject to the application of extensions determined in accordance with paragraph 4 of this Article and to the application of paragraphs 5 to 7b thereof without prejudice to paragraph 8 of this Article and subject to the application of Article 11(3)(j);
targets.label: objective
targets.timeline: at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive
indicators: balance between abstraction and recharge of groundwater
targets.source: FIX-CONSOLIDATED: 'paragraphs 5, 6 and 7' -> 'paragraphs 5 to 7b thereof'; re-sliced from 02000L0060-20260510.

targets.quote: Member States shall implement the measures necessary to reverse any significant and sustained upward trend in the concentration of any pollutant resulting from the impact of human activity in order progressively to reduce pollution of groundwater.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Member States shall achieve compliance with any standards and objectives at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive, unless otherwise specified in the Community legislation under which the individual protected areas have been established.
targets.label: objective
targets.timeline: at the latest 15 years after the date of entry into force of this Directive
indicators: compliance with protected-area standards and objectives
